title: A viewer refused for lack of cores while a new worker is starting could be held for it instead of refused
notes: Promote when JS-057 measures demand-to-ready under about 10 seconds and its 14-day count shows refusals followed by a successful retry (D-045). JS-166: pod creation to first claim 1.7 and 5.5 s on one node, 7.7, 37 and 58 s on another (unexplained).
